name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $61,600 on 20 Nov, its lowest since July and 29% below its high; no de-peg or exchange failure
state: Bitcoin was near $61,611 early on 20 Nov, 28.9% below its 52-week high of $86,603, 5.7% lower on the week and 20% lower over a month (Yahoo Finance). It fell to its lowest since early July on 19 Nov, heading for a seventh straight weekly loss amid the equity sell-off and Fed rate-rise fears (CoinDesk). The drawdown is past the 25% Watch line; no major stablecoin de-peg or top-10 exchange failure was found.
for_you: Crypto prices are in a prolonged decline and remain highly volatile. Holders are exposed to further large swings.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Bitcoin plunges to lowest since July as broader markets tumble

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
